page.layout: One column of running text, with small marginal notes down the left margin. A printed page number and running head sit at the top. At the foot are a signature at the left and a catchword at the right.

main_text.p: ædificatione & salute occupemus aliena & no-stra. Etenim cum in terris nulla tam exigua herba fit, quæ, rorem à Deo nō sentiat, quæ non utatur, & quæ non occupet eum ad testificationem gloriæ Deo auctori omnis boni tribuendæ: indignissimum illud est, si nos tam multis à natura bonis instructi, & aucti gratia copiosa atque infinita segnescamus in officio hoc, & Deo palàm proclamante, Ecce, & Angelis hominibusq. in Ecclesia, extraque Ecclesiam spectantibus, non demus operam, vt bonum hoc à Deo collatum ad Dei gloriam & communionem corporis, quod Christus sanguine suo redemit, & in quo sumus ipsi, vicissim referamus.

[illegible, ~3 letters]Enimuerò cur segnescamus, aut aliud agamus in hoc opere sanctissimo, quod Deus nobis imperat Prophetæ verbis? Deus non segnescit benefaciendo, dat omnibus, nemini exprobrat, suppeditat omnia, suggerit commodè velut rorem herbæ: idque non semel, sed indefinenter stillantibus è cælo benedictionibus eius. Quid est, siue in nobis, siue extra nos, quod ab officio hoc sanctissimo nos auocare possit, cum Deus aduocat, & omnia quæ sunt opus ad hoc officium nostrum sapientissimè, commodissimè, & utilitate summa communicat? Si alienū vitium offensasq. esse nobis impedimento querimur; quid nos vulneramus alieno vulnere? quid cadimus in alieno casu? quid aliena macula infami maculamur? alienum malum curemus potiùs, quàm vt participemus: malū non curatur ma-

page.notes: The left margin carries about thirty small fragments of marginal notes. They are cropped at the scan edge and too faint to read, so only the first is represented, as an illegible placeholder. The other fragments are not transcribed. The word "lo." printed at the foot beside the signature is the continuation of "ma-" ("malo"); it is not part of the running text. Signature "S ij" is uncertain. Handwriting at top right ("2 4 8") is excluded. The running head is printed with an accent over the E in SECVNDA, which is not reproduced.
